vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s, with a missing fingertip telling A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut about A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The retelling is already better than the event.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."
🛡️ Saul, Mohammed, Natalia and Mara met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Saul, Natalia, Mara are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mohammed just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ LaToya, Saul, Mohammed, Natalia and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. LaToya, Saul, Mohammed, Natalia, Mara are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. 📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James met them at the door — 1 put down. James is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
